# ALTCTRL Solutions

> ALTCTRL is a clinical workflow software company based in Mississauga, Ontario. It builds Windows-native, Canadian-hosted software that closes the loops healthcare leaves open, starting with RetinaLoop for diabetic eye care (pilot program, Ontario). It also runs ALTCTRL Services, a hands-on IT practice for clinics and households across the GTA, and ALTCTRL Labs, its R&D arm.

- Products: RetinaLoop helps optometry and retina clinics find overdue diabetic patients, recall them, report results to family doctors and send triaged referrals. Workflow software only: it does not diagnose or grade images. Currently a pilot program with a small founding cohort of Ontario clinics.
- Services (live): managed IT for clinics and small offices; same-day repair, BitLocker recovery (in-person only), data recovery and remote rescue for households. No fix, no fee.
- Labs (R&D): prototyping privacy-first clinical software and private AI infrastructure with design partners. Designed for PHIPA with Canadian data residency.

Contact: jaleed01@altctrl.run · +1-647-643-7979
